QUOTE: sets the global pointers to its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`, or to `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` installs plain buffer_alloc functions, or the `_mutexed` variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on. That covers the mutexed-versus-plain choice inside the init function. The answer doesn't use the words "compile time", but the `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` condition is a build-time macro.
